messages:
elaine: Hey team — saw a CS ticket where our JS SDK surfaces a generic `Error: Bad request` for a 400, but Go spits out `InvalidArgument: prompt too long`. New user on the sampleapp was confused. Anyone remember the intended error mapping?
jordan: We landed on typed client errors for 4xx (non-retriable) and typed server/transient for 5xx. But if sampleapp uses the raw HTTP wrapper it won't get the typed surface.
sam: Can you paste the payload / minimal repro?
elaine: Here's the body from the ticket (redacted):
```json
{"prompt":"<~15k chars>"}
```
Customer sees in Chrome console: `Error: Bad request` — no code or hint. In Go SDK they get `InvalidArgument: prompt too long` (with a `hint`).
pat: That smells like JS unwrap logic: if body.message exists we use it, otherwise fallback to `statusText`. We should prefer our structured error envelope: `{code, human_message, hint, retryable}`.
maria: We have the internal RFC for the canonical error shape (RFC link in #docs). TL;DR: `code` (string), `human_message` (string), optional `retry_after` (int seconds), `http_status` (int), and `hint`. SDKs should expose typed exceptions/classes for the common codes.
jordan: CS reports ~3 tickets this week with the same confusion; onboarding friction is real.
elaine: Also sampleapp README currently says `if err.type == 'InvalidArgument'` which only exists in Go. So the quickstart is giving the wrong hint to JS users.
sam: Proposal: 1) standardize wire shape across endpoints; 2) JS SDK: throw typed Error subclasses (e.g., `InvalidArgumentError`, `RateLimitError`) with properties `{code, humanMessage, hint, retryAfter}`; 3) update sampleapp and quickstart to use the typed surface and add a small migration note.
pat: +1. One edge: streaming endpoints won't always have a body to parse on socket close — we should set a sentinel header like `x-rw-error: 1` and include a compact JSON blob in the final trailer when possible.
maria: Also make sure 429 maps to `RateLimit` and include `retry_after` in the envelope (seconds) so SDKs can surface `err.retryAfter`.
jordan: Can we add a tiny mapping table in docs: e.g. `400 -> InvalidArgument`, `401 -> AuthError`, `403 -> PermissionDenied`, `404 -> NotFound`, `409 -> Conflict`, `429 -> RateLimit(retry_after)`, `5xx -> ServerError (retriable)`. Keep it prescriptive.
elaine: Good. I'll open the sampleapp PR to remove the `err.type` example and add a JS snippet showing `instanceof` checks.
sam: I'll own the JS SDK changes (class-based errors + tests). ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow. I'll also add a compatibility layer that maps older `message` bodies to the new shape for one release.
pat: For the docs side I'll draft the mapping table + examples (copyable snippets) — will ping legal if we need to change support copy.
maria: One more UX note: `human_message` should never dump stack traces or raw model debug. Keep it short and actionable (e.g., 'prompt exceeds 8192 tokens; try shortening or using summarization').
jordan: I'll add a linter rule to SDK repos to enforce the presence of `human_message` and `code` on constructed errors.
elaine: Timeline check — CS wants a quick patch this week.
sam: Sampleapp patch by Fri, JS SDK PR by tomorrow EOD. I'll post links here. :thumbsup: 
devex-bot: Created issue RW-1234 — "SDK error parity + sampleapp onboarding fixes" assigned to sam. https://github.com/redwood/sdk/issues/1234
pat: Nice. After PRs merge, can we add a tiny smoke test in deploy pipeline that validates sampleapp surfaces typed errors for common bad requests?
maria: Yes — I'll add an integration test that hits our staging model with a known-too-long prompt and asserts `err.code == 'InvalidArgument' && typeof err.human_message == 'string'`.
sam: Pushed branch: github.com/redwood/js-sdk/tree/feature/error-classes (PR soon).
elaine: Thank you all — I'll coordinate with CS to mark the affected tickets and follow up after the deploy. ❤️
